data.content:
The only remaining error is `CS5001` (no `Main` method) — that's a **pre-existing issue** unrelated to the migration. All migration-related code compiles cleanly.

Here's a summary of the **4 breaking changes** addressed:

| # | Breaking Change | Impact on Your 500K Docs | Fix Applied |
|---|----------------|-------------------------|-------------|
| **1** | Discriminator renamed `"Discriminator"` → `"$type"` | EF9 can't find existing docs; raw SQL `c.Discriminator` queries return nothing | `HasDiscriminator<string>("Discriminator")` preserves old name |
| **2** | Id format changed `"Product|123"` → `"123"` | EF9 can't load any existing document by key | `LegacyCosmosIdGenerator` keeps writing `"Product|{PK}"` format |
| **3** | `HasIndex()` now throws for Cosmos | Build fails at model creation | Removed (was always a no-op) |
| **4** | Sync I/O (`ToList`, `First`, etc.) throws `InvalidOperationException` | Runtime crash on every query | Changed to `async`/`ToListAsync` |

**Changes 1 and 2 are the most dangerous** — without the backward-compat configuration, EF9 silently writes new documents in the new format while being unable to read any of your 500K existing ones.
